mapper.select:
SELECT s.* FROM schedule s INNER JOIN teaching_task tt ON s.teaching_task_id = tt.id AND tt.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN class_info cl ON s.class_id = cl.id AND cl.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN classroom cr ON s.classroom_id = cr.id AND cr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON s.time_slot_id = ts.id WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
AND cl.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{className}, '%')
AND cr.room_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roomName}, '%')
AND ts.day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek}
AND s.semester_id = #{semesterId}
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC
